youtube_title: Hunter's Moon tonight: when it rises over La Porte, Indiana
body: Tonight's full moon is the Hunter's Moon 🌕 It rises over La Porte at 5:16 p.m., low in the east-northeast. The sun doesn't set until 5:51, so you can catch it coming up in daylight. It's officially full at 11:12 tonight, and the forecast is partly cloudy with a low around 47. On Halloween, the moon won't rise until 10:49 p.m., so bring a flashlight for trick-or-treat. Going out to see it? Share your moon photos! #LaPorte #HuntersMoon #FullMoon #Indiana #MichiganCity #Halloween

youtube_title: Indiana's #1 Halloween candy isn't chocolate (2026 rankings)
body: Indiana's most popular Halloween candy this year isn't chocolate 🍬 It's NERDS Gummy Clusters, in CandyStore.com's 2026 state-by-state rankings. Next door, Illinois picked Sour Patch Kids, Michigan went with Starburst, Ohio chose Blow Pops, and in Kentucky it's Reese's Cups. Nationally, the top five are M&M's, Sour Patch Kids, Skittles, Reese's Cups and NERDS Gummy Clusters. Agree? Tell us the best candy to get in La Porte! #LaPorte #Halloween #HalloweenCandy #Indiana #MichiganCity #TrickOrTreat

youtube_title: Clocks fall back Nov. 1: La Porte's sunsets jump an hour earlier
body: Clocks fall back one week from today ⏰ Daylight saving time ends at 2 a.m. next Sunday, Nov. 1, so set your clocks back an hour Saturday night (yes, Halloween night). Phones change on their own; the oven and microwave won't. La Porte's sunset jumps from 5:43 p.m. on Halloween to 4:41 p.m. the next day, and keeps sliding to 4:17 by early December. The upside: sunrise moves from 7:18 to 6:19 a.m. Love it or hate it? #LaPorte #FallBack #DaylightSaving #Indiana #MichiganCity
